notes.notes:
Hi All

We are super excited to announce that we have, not one, but two new visual novels coming soon!! 
LoveKami -Healing Harem-, the third instalment in the LoveKami series, and If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-, a continuation to the highly popular If My Heart Had Wings, are coming soon to Steam.   


[h1]LoveKami -Healing Harem-[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/31b8a8afaff2b9dcde2c80b61651f26d93867c08.jpg[/img]

[i]"I'll find a solution to the goddess' problems!"[/i]

The more things seem the same, the more they're actually different... 
These are some strange little stories about Goddesses in love. 
They happened in a time when Goddesses and people lived in close proximity, six years after the Goddesses descended to Earth.

Our story takes place in Kamimori City, a community deep in the mountains that is known among some people for one thing; the area is protected by a Tatarigami.
Tatarigami are known for spreading misfortune, but Kamimori City is protected by one.

Akira Manase has inherited a shrine in Kamimori City, and spent his days listening to the Goddess' troubles. One day, he helped one of the Tatarigami, Yukari, and she fell madly in love with him, almost immediately proposing marriage.

[i]"Please make me your wife!"[/i]

However, there were Goddesses other than Yukari who were also in love with Akira, and they were intent on staking their claim. As the Goddesses vie for his hand in marriage, Akira spends his days helping them solve their problems.

LoveKami -Healing Harem- will be descending to Steam this Fall!

https://youtu.be/ftBGA7BNMa0 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/938270/LoveKami_Healing_Harem 



[h1]If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/276055ecd8f547a664550b06d5697e8bbd659efb.jpg[/img]

[i]"All people meet in the sky!"[/i]

A group of boys and girls encounter the sky and begin weaving a tale of dreams. 
They dream of soaring to the far side of the clouds, on wings onto which they've poured their hopes and wishes.

Our story takes place in Kazegaura, a lovely little town where a boy named Aoi Minase and his friends wait on a hill lined with windmills for a pleasant wind to blow through.
Once again, they await the time for departure; to take off on the sprawling, white wings of a glider.

If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- includes six stories - including the prologue and epilogue to the main story - and acts as a sort of sequel to the original, If My Heart Had Wings.

A young girl in a high school uniform, with blonde hair and blue eyes.
This half-Japanese, half-American girl Hiroki meets on the ferry heading to the island says she’s on her way to Ogasawara, which has a special place in her parents’ hearts.

Possibly due to the fact that she basically ran away from home to make the journey, at first she seems extremely suspicious of those around her, and she has quite the attitude.
Every once in awhile, she shows signs of something troubling her, deep down inside.
However, while her personality is actually somewhat shy, she also has a bit of naiveté about her and forges ahead full of baseless confidence.
Coming from a wealthy family and fortunate enough to be aesthetically stunning, she sometimes also shows flashes of a “less fortunate” side as well.

She’s also a total beginner at diving.
Due to her fear of sharks, she’s also afraid of the sea in general, and is completely unable to swim.
But thanks to the support of her friends and a stray dolphin, she manages to overcome her fears.

We are super excited to announce that [i]CROSS†CHANNEL: Steam Edition[/i], is releasing on Steam this Spring 2018. [i]Steam Edition[/i] is based on the definitive PS3/PS Vita release [i]CROSS†CHANNEL ~For all people~[/i], and marks the first time [i]CROSS†CHANNEL[/i] has been officially localized.

Set in Gunjo Gakuin, a school specialized for those deemed by the government to be unfit for society, [i]CROSS†CHANNEL[/i] follows the story of eight members of the school's Broadcasting Club who have just returned from a disastrous field trip, which throws their club – and their friendships – into turmoil. 
Upon returning to school, the students quickly discover that they are the only living people around. Completely alone and rife with tension, will the students manage to mend their broken friendships and complete their broadcasting antenna in order to reach out to other possible survivors of whatever mysterious calamity has befallen them?
